Sort out the perfect order of a distinct set of four symbols!

Depending on the order of all symbols is the system's performance. Each symbol can only be present once.

Here are the symbols:

A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceeeded by symbol A or C
C = yields best performance unless it is the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

The optimal order for the given set of symbols is:

D - B - C - A

Explanation:

1. D is the first symbol, which satisfies its condition and ensures best performance.
2. B is the second symbol, which cannot be preceded by A or C, so it is placed after D.
3. C is the third symbol, which cannot be the last symbol, so it is placed before A.
4. A is the fourth symbol, which cannot be followed by more than one symbol, so it is placed last.

This order satisfies all the conditions mentioned for each symbol, resulting in the best overall performance.
